subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android Chat add a dedicated on-device Dictation action beside Voice Note and Talk, or continue relying on keyboard dictation and the existing voice entry points?
rationale: This is a new first-class composer action in an app explicitly under active rebuild; implementation quality alone cannot decide whether the extra microphone mode and control fit the intended Android UX.

options.title: Sponsor After Proof
options.body: Approve the dedicated Dictation action once successful transcript insertion is proven and the stacked ownership work is landable.

options.title: Use Existing Voice Paths
options.body: Decline the extra composer action and keep inline speech entry delegated to the system keyboard while retaining Voice Note and Talk.

options.title: Request Product Issue
options.body: Pause this PR until a focused Android feature issue compares control placement, recognizer availability, privacy expectations, and fallback UX.

recommendation.title: Sponsor After Proof
recommendation.body: Approve the dedicated Dictation action once successful transcript insertion is proven and the stacked ownership work is landable.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository documentation explicitly assigns Android app ownership to @obviyus.
